# Felix Ortmann

> Sovereign cloud & Kubernetes platforms on STACKIT and Scaleway. Senior DevOps & platform engineer with 15+ years in distributed systems. I design, build and review Kubernetes platforms on European clouds – GitOps, multi-tenancy and cost transparency included.

Freelance · Hamburg · Remote across the EU. Available from January 2027.

## Services
- **Platform engineering & GitOps**: Kubernetes platforms built to be operated: ArgoCD hub-and-spoke, OpenTofu, Helm and Kustomize, Kyverno, observability, secrets and certificates – from first cluster to handover.
- **Migration to European clouds**: From on-premise or hyperscaler to STACKIT or Scaleway: provider evaluation, migration plan, hands-on execution, with GDPR in mind.
- **Architecture reviews**: ADR-style reviews of Kubernetes and cloud platforms: architecture, operability, tenant isolation, cost and delivery pipelines. Clear findings, prioritized recommendations.

## Selected work
- **Schwarz Digits – Industrial Edge Platform** (2026): Federated ArgoCD platform on STACKIT serving many internal tenants, including air-gapped production plants. I designed the FinOps strategy and implemented multi-tenancy with Capsule and Kyverno without Capsule Proxy, including CLI self-service. Result: Infrastructure costs cut by nearly 50% within the first month.
- **uni-assist – Migration to Scaleway** (2023 – 2025): Legacy Docker Swarm on-premise, moved to a GDPR-compliant Kubernetes landscape aligned with CIS Controls v8. Led an 11-person team, bootstrapped Terraform, ArgoCD and GitLab CI, replaced the legacy VPN with mTLS PKI and AD integration. Result: Full production migration – infrastructure, services, data – completed.
- **GUS Group – Cloud kickoff on STACKIT** (2026): Starting from zero: OpenTofu and ArgoCD hub-and-spoke foundation, SKE, Gateway API, External Secrets, cert-manager, observability and dashboards-as-code. The platform hosts the client's MCP server for AI agent integration. Result: Platform foundation in place within three months.

## Current stack
- Kubernetes: Kubernetes, Helm, Kustomize, Kyverno, cert-manager, External Secrets, external-dns, Gateway API
- Multi-Tenancy & FinOps: Clastix Capsule, Kyverno policies, FinOps cost attribution, Air-gapped edge
- Cloud: STACKIT, Scaleway
- IaC & GitOps: OpenTofu, Terraform, ArgoCD
- CI/CD: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps
- Observability: Grafana, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Alloy, Prometheus, Thanos, VictoriaMetrics
- Identity & Networking: Keycloak, Vault, OIDC / OAuth, mTLS & PKI, ingress-nginx
- Linux & Scripting: Linux, Arch Linux, Bash, Go, Python, Docker
- AI & Agentic Engineering: Claude Code, MCP
- Also: Managed PostgreSQL & MySQL, RabbitMQ
- Earlier (not in active use): AWS, GCP, OpenShift, Pulumi, Jenkins, TeamCity, ELK stack, WireGuard
